cover_dek: The central bank meets for its final decision before the midterm elections.
big_headline: The US Federal Reserve is expected to leave interest rates unchanged on Wednesday.
big_body: This meeting is the last rate-setting decision before the midterm elections. Rates sit at one of the highest pre-election levels in over 20 years.
